summary: Merck & Co., Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of unsecured senior notes (floating rate and fixed rate) to refinance borrowings used to fund the recently closed acquisition of Terns Pharmaceuticals. The filing is a routine debt capital markets transaction; no special-situation event is triggered as the acquisition has already closed and the offering is a financing activity. No deal terms such as price per share, premium, or other M&A specifics are applicable. The notes are not listed on any exchange.
